$comment: Tags of Drizzle migrations that were hand-authored (not produced by drizzle-kit generate) and therefore intentionally lack a meta/000N_snapshot.json. ADR-002 IMPL-A reads this file to skip the snapshot-presence check for these tags. Adding a new entry requires (a) the migration tag matches a journal entry, (b) a brief reason inline below, (c) operator sign-off in PR review (hand-written migrations are spine-adjacent per ENTITY.md §1).

$schema.tags: string[] — must match meta/_journal.json entries by `tag` field

reasons.0002_chat: Hand-authored chat-channels/messages/members/events migration before drizzle-kit generate was wired for that subgraph; tracked by ADR-002 §Context.
reasons.0003_tenant_bootstrap: Hand-authored tenant-bootstrap seed migration; idempotent INSERT ON CONFLICT pattern that drizzle-kit cannot emit.
